title: Improve documentation of kube play
body:
This is a minor improvement in `podman kube play` documentation.

I accidentally discover that `podman kube play` uses only the name of the image (ignores the registry and tag) to search for a matching directory name.

This pull request reflects this behavior in the documentation to have it clear for readers.

#### Minimal Working Example

```
$ tree .
.
├── foo
│   └── Containerfile
└── mwe.pod

2 directories, 2 files
$ cat mwe.pod 
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: mwe
spec:
  containers:
    - name: mwe
      image: docker.io/library/foo:bar
      command:
        - tail
        - -f
        - /dev/null
$ podman kube play --replace mwe.pod 
Pods stopped:
Pods removed:
Secrets removed:
Volumes removed:
STEP 1/1: FROM docker.io/library/alpine
COMMIT docker.io/library/foo:bar
--> 706db57fb206
Successfully tagged docker.io/library/foo:bar
Successfully tagged docker.io/library/alpine:latest
Successfully tagged docker.io/library/alpine:3.22
706db57fb2063f39f69632c5b5c9c439633fda35110e65587c5d85553fd1cc38
Pod:
38dd9e2e0b8d73bcc5c365e93397aff29a47f9e5c7ed4a9b323c6fd64020f7b2
Container:
4bdb5112de0ecef312ba3c7140e8524b4d5ad703e72491bfd003090ab01be047
```

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

None
